say:1:1521224001:1.text: Now that the locusts are out of the way, people can finally come home. But we need to clear the place first.
say:1:1521224001:1.source_cn: 是啊，那些针蝗消失了，这些村庄陆陆续续也得清理出来，准...
say:1:1521224001:1.male: Now that the locusts are out of the way, people can finally come home. But we need to clear the place first.
say:1:1521224001:1.female: Now that the locusts are out of the way, people can finally come home. But we need to clear the place first.

say:2:1521224002:1.text: To be honest, we knew things would be bad when we got here.
say:2:1521224002:1.source_cn: 说实话，我们来之前就预想过，村庄内的状况一定不怎么好。
say:2:1521224002:1.male: To be honest, we knew things would be bad when we got here.
say:2:1521224002:1.female: To be honest, we knew things would be bad when we got here.

say:3:1521224003:1.source_cn: 但没想到，竟然会有如此惨状……

say:4:1521224004:1.text: And now... we have to tell their families what happened... How do we even begin?
say:4:1521224004:1.source_cn: 哎，后续我们还要与死者的亲属交代情况。这……我们可怎么...
say:4:1521224004:1.male: And now... we have to tell their families what happened... How do we even begin?
say:4:1521224004:1.female: And now... we have to tell their families what happened... How do we even begin?
